approval.rationale: Initial framework discovery and charter approved.

data.missionStatement: Deliver a reusable, portable, local-first AI Project Orchestrator framework establishing shared contracts, deterministic lifecycle gates, and anti-slop quality standards.
targetAudience: AI Coding Agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Antigravity)
inScope: Canonical JSON schema definitions for all project contracts
G0-G6 lifecycle state machine and gate enforcement
Mandatory baseline and specialized quality profiles
outOfScope: Hosted cloud service or SaaS control plane
Vendor-specific binary plugins or marketplace distribution

constraints.description: Zero external mandatory dependencies for core validation; run on standard Python 3.10+.
Local-first privacy; no secrets or private repository code sent to remote endpoints.
Strict preservation of existing repository conventions and uncommitted user edits.

assumptions: Environment provides a standard command execution shell and file system access.
Git is installed and configured in the repository root.
